meta.title: Small Wants
meta.determinism: All randomness derives from random.Random(seed). Same seed -> identical run. City generation uses rng key 'city-<gen_seed>'; run rng uses seed directly.
meta.numbers_policy: game_model.json is the single source of truth for all numbers. GDD.md must match it exactly.

pillars: Every trade and every word feeds a person's greed or heals it, and the cause is always visible to the player as a list of reasons.
Greed is contagious (prices, gossip, neighborhoods), and healing is never permanent.
The player is corrupted by greed too, and getting too rich gets the player killed.
The game feels endless: many different runs, not a 2-3 hour experience.
The simulation stays simple enough for a player to observe and understand.

clock.notes: Tutorial days 1-2 are the opening (2 actions/day). The ledger unlocks on day 3 at the shop.

fear.cure: Make them feel secure: steady supply and fair prices
fear.special: Fair/generous GOODS deals add 'Steady supply' -7 (4d). Debt reasons weigh x1.5. Hungry/Shortage reasons weigh x1.3.

pride.cure: Honest, humble dealing that does not feed their status
pride.special: Flattery is the fastest corrupter (x1.8); humble honest words heal best.
pride.district: The Hill (plus most of the Counting House)

envy.cure: Fix the hub they are copying
envy.special: Lowest contagion threshold: tips first from neighbors, hubs and rumors; heals fastest when its hub falls in line.

trade.fair_price_rule: fair_price = item base price (goods 10, favor 8, secret 15, time 5), modified by market heat: x(1 + (heat-50)/200). Deal tilt = (paid - fair)/fair.

goods.side: Market heat responds (see market.rules). Fair/generous goods to a fear person also add 'Steady supply'.

favor.side: Trust gain x1.3; adds 'Owes the player a favor' +3 (6d), x1.5 on fear.

secret.side: Traded secrets spread by gossip. Exposing an unprotected discovered secret triggers exposure cascade.

time.side: Positive reason durations on the target +50% (patience).

trust_multipliers.heal_mult: 0.65 + 0.72 * trust/100   (applied to negative greed deltas, then x(1 - weariness): trust amplifies healing)
trust_multipliers.harm_mult: 1.25 - 0.50 * trust/100   (applied to positive greed deltas from DEALS: trust softens damage)
trust_multipliers.word_mult: 0.60 + 0.70 * trust/100   (applied to ALL word deltas: low trust weakens words both ways)

trade.result_formula: greed_delta = (deal.greed * type_reaction[deal] * item_mult * harm_or_heal_mult) + (intent.greed * type_reaction[intent] * word_mult); trust_delta = deal.trust + intent.trust (favor item: x1.3)

witness_ripple.targets: up to 4 others in the same district (nearest neighbors first)
witness_ripple.player_greed_amplifier: x1.25 on hostile deals only (tilted/exploitative/threatening) while player greed >= 60 - your cruelty spreads; your charity does not
witness_ripple.valve: x0.5 while safety valve is active

favor.note: Doing a favor: they owe you (debt reason), trust up.

give_away.note: Pure charity to a poor person; no deal, no words.

work_shop.note: Mind the counter; no social effect.

expose_secret.effects_note: gossip cascade: 3 random people hear the secret (+4 greed, 2d)

promise.note: Creates a pending promise; keep it (favor effect) or betray it.

reasons.format: Each reason = {label, delta, days}. Greed = clamp(base_greed + sum(active reason deltas), 0, 100). Deltas fade linearly over their duration, then drop off.

neighbors_narrow.label: Content neighbors
neighbors_narrow.delta: dynamic: -(20 - min(12, 1.5 * days since the district last saw you))

scar_owner_killed.label: The last shop owner was killed

witness.label: Saw the deal
witness.delta: dynamic: 0.30 x target's net greed delta

pg_hoarding.condition: applied daily while wealth > 2 * median person wealth

contagion.model: Granovetter/Watts threshold model, run once per day per person over their neighbor set.
contagion.neighbor_weights: Same-district ring neighbors weight 1; hubs count weight 2 anywhere they appear.
contagion.rule: greedy_frac = sum(weight of greedy neighbors) / sum(all neighbor weights). If greedy_frac >= contagion_threshold[type], renew 'Greedy neighbors' +15 (2d). If no same-district neighbor is greedy and all same-district neighbors are narrow (greed <= 25), renew 'Content neighbors': a shield of -(20 - min(12, 1.5 * days since the district last saw you)) (2d) - visited districts hold at -20, abandoned ones rot back toward -8. Narrow people take contagion-tagged reasons at x0.5 (the content resist pressure).
contagion.valve: While the safety valve is active, thresholds are +0.05 harder to cross and the 'Greedy neighbors' delta is halved to +6.
contagion.secret_people: Un-corrupted secret people receive contagion-tagged reasons (neighbors, prices, gossip, rumor, stranger tales) at x0.3 - they look immune.

gossip.daily: Each greedy person (greed >= their tip) spreads gossip with 30% chance/day; a greedy hub with 60% chance/day to 2 targets. Target: 65% same district, 35% any district. Effect: 'Gossip: someone struck it rich' +4 (2d).
gossip.player_gossip: While player greed >= 60: 12%/day a random person hears 'the shopkeeper hoards coin' -> trust reason -2 (6d) and greed reason hoard_envy +3 (2d). Your own greed becomes gossip.

market.heat_daily_drift: heat += (mean greed of Market Square people - 50) * 0.04, clamped to [0,100]
market.deal_effects: Tilted/exploitative GOODS deal in Market Square: heat +3. Fair/generous GOODS deal in Market Square: heat -2.
market.price_reasons: heat >= 60: everyone in Market Square gets 'Prices rising' +5 (3d) renewed daily. heat >= 75: ALL districts get 'Prices rising' +6 (3d) - a citywide price spiral.
market.note: This is the price channel of contagion: greedy sellers push heat up, heat pushes reasons onto everyone.

earned_by: Repeated fair deals over time (tr_fair, tr_generous)
trust_rules.decay: Trust reasons fade on their own durations; unattended trust drifts back toward the person's base.
trust_rules.visibility: trust >= 25: fuzzy greed estimate + partial 'why' list. trust >= 60: exact reason list, secret hint, and their true tip threshold.
trust_rules.formula: trust = clamp(20 + base_offset + sum(trust reason deltas), 0, 100); base_offset = person.base_trust - 20

relapse.mechanic: A narrow person tracks last_positive_day. After grace_days without any positive contact, 'Old habit creeping back' +8 (+10 if at least half their neighbors are greedy) is re-added each neglected day (3d fade, stacking to ~+16/day of pressure) and is cleared entirely by any positive contact. Neglect alone drifts a healed person to an uneasy plateau; the relapse COMPLETES when any greedy pressure joins them. Betrayal (+18) completes it instantly.
relapse.hysteresis: base_greed drifts down 4/day while greed <= 25 (floor 15; the want narrows) and back up 3.5/day while greed >= 45 (cap at initial base). Healing lowers the floor; neglect lets it climb back fast.
relapse.stated_guarantee: A neglected narrow person under active neighbor pressure (their contagion threshold crossed) relapses within 12 days of the last positive contact, typically 4-8. A neglected person with no pressure holds at an uneasy plateau until pressure arrives. A fully narrow (content-shielded) neighborhood holds as long as the shield stands.
relapse.relapse_scorn: When a person you had healed tips back to greedy, they add trust reason 'You healed me, then left me' -18 (16d), and each relapse adds 15% weariness (max 40%) to all future healing on them. Healing the same person twice is harder - neglect has a compounding cost.
relapse.weariness: Each relapse adds 15% weariness (max 35%) to all future healing on that person; weariness decays 2%/day as the city forgets the routine. Healing the same person twice is harder, but not forever.

raises: Hoarding (wealth > 2x median) +4/day - a growing coffers feeds itself
lowers: Give away -2 (fair deals are greed-neutral: they pay the bills, they do not purify)
player_greed_rules.effects: Player greed >= 60: trade ripple x1.5, player becomes gossip subject, fallen-healer risk. Healer ending needs player greed < 40; fallen healer needs >= 65.
player_greed_rules.note: Tilted/exploitative deals corrupt the player hard: one corrupted slot per day outweighs three healing slots. That is what makes the fallen-healer path playable and the greedy path fast.

danger.visibility: Hidden. The player only sees warning stages.
danger.formula_readable: gain_raw = (3.5*max(0,(wealth-40)/100) + 2*max(0,wealth/median_person_wealth - 3) + distrust) * (1.4 - 0.8*mean_trust/100); distrust = 1.5 if mean_trust < 40 (+1.5 more if < 25); gain = min(gain_raw, 14); danger += gain - decay; decay = 4 if wealth < 100 else 2
danger.gain_cap_reason: A mob needs time to organize: rumor must spread, grudges must gather. The cap guarantees at least 5 days of warnings between stage 1 (danger 30) and death (danger 100).

warnings.sign: Stares and whispers: people watch you shop.
Overcharging and snubs: prices quietly rise for you, old friends are cold.
Threats and break-ins: thieves target the shop.
The mob gathers at your door at night.

danger.death: danger >= 100: the city kills the player. Doom ending (killed).

safety_valve.locked_intent: Keeps a very dark city recoverable (RimWorld-expectations inspired).

effects.base_sink_condition: city_greed >= 80 (the dying line: while the collapse timer runs, everyone's settled want shrinks 1.5/day)

safety_valve.readable: At 76 the dying zone opens (collapse timer: 76 held for 8 days = doom_collapsed); at 80 the dying city's standards start collapsing (base sink 1.5/day) and at 85 despair peaks and the valve turns on fully (help x2, greed barely spreads, shock events). Darkness is a race between the collapse timer and the city's own despair - and the despair usually wins if anyone is working the city.

secret_people.locked_definition: Appear immune to greed but hide a secret: they are greedy about food or money specifically. Fragile and easy to corrupt.
secret_people.discovery: trust >= 42 reveals a hint ('you have seen where they stash bread/coins'), then their secret and true nature. Discovery is checked nightly.
secret_people.corruption: A tilted or exploitative deal in their weak-spot item (food = goods, money = coin) adds 'Taste of easy coin' +12 (10d), removes immunity, and sets greed_growth_mult = 1.5 forever.
secret_people.protect: protect_secret action: trust +10, greed -2; a protected secret can never be exposed.
secret_people.peace: A secret person healed below narrow_max with their secret protected reaches 'at peace' (base floor 10): the hardest cure, the longest hold.

promises.make: promise action: +8 trust now, pending promise recorded.
promises.betray: betray: 'Betrayed a promise' +15 (10d) on the victim, trust -25, player greed +5. Betrayal is the fastest way to relapse a healed person.
promises.note: Favors owed are tracked separately as debt reasons.

shop_and_progression.look_reflects_greed: Shop sprite and interior degrade/ornament with player greed tiers (0-25 plain, 26-50 polished, 51-75 gilded, 76+ sickly gold and barloys of coin).

upgrades.effect: +1 buy/sell slot per day; buy prices 10% better.
Store secrets/favors safely; thieves events cannot touch them.
Every other day gain a 5th action (hosting).

shop_and_progression.ledger: Unlocked day 3. Holds the previous owner's last month of entries (see previous_owner). After a death, the heir's ledger also contains the last run's summary: end day, wealth, danger stage, who tipped when.
shop_and_progression.wall_of_owners: Adopted: one portrait per finished run with its ending; hangs in the shop across all cities.
shop_and_progression.new_items: Seasons REJECTED for 1.0; new trade items unlock via shop upgrades (shelf 2 adds cloth/tools).
shop_and_progression.sim_coverage: Upgrades abstracted out of sim.py (economy depth is out of scope for loop proofing); everything else numeric here is simulated.

storyteller.style: RimWorld-like pacing: picks 0-1 events/day with probability event_chance, weighted among eligible events; pressure events dominate in dark cities, kindness events in healing cities; eases off when the player is drowning (no thieves below danger 65, no famine while the city is already dark).

events.name: Tax collector
events.effects: takes 12% of player wealth; 'Someone richer paid the tax' -4 (2d) to all. Rich players attract the collector.

events.name: A stranger arrives
events.effects: 'Stranger's tales of riches' +10 (6d) to one random non-secret person

events.name: A rumor
events.effects: 'Rumor of new riches' +4 (2d) on 4 random people, sourced from a greedy hub

events.name: Market crash
events.effects: heat -25; 'Market crash' -10 (3d) on Market Square and The Hill

events.name: A scandal
events.effects: a random greedy hub falls: -20 greed instantly; envy people 'The mighty have fallen' -6 (3d)

events.name: A wedding
events.condition: two narrow people share a district

doom_collapsed.readable: The city collapses into pure greed.

healer.when: day >= 12 AND city_greed <= 20 AND every hub narrow (greed <= 25) AND player_greed < 40 AND player greed PEAK < 55 AND mean_trust >= 30
healer.readable: The city is cured, it trusts you, and you stayed good.

fallen_healer.when: city_greed <= 20 AND player greed PEAK >= 55 (peak greed latches: you became greedy, even if finishing the cure purifies part of it)
fallen_healer.readable: You cured the city, and it corrupted you.

tycoon.readable: You got very rich and slipped out before the city turned. The knife-edge: danger 36 at the moment you cross 250.

endings.day_cap: day > 80: run ends 'day_cap' (the road goes on). Counted as a non-ending outcome for reporting.
endings.notes: Priority order means a cured city with player greed 40-64 and wealth < 250 keeps playing: the player must choose who they become.

healer.trinket: Fenn's Scale: prices show their fair value (QoL, no math change)
healer.readable: Your reputation precedes you: trust starts higher.

tycoon.readable: You arrive rich: the gap and the danger start high on day one.

fallen_healer.readable: Rumors preceded you, and your greed came with you: you may be the one who spreads it (ripple x1.5 applies from day one).

doom_killed.city_state: preserved: all greed, trust and heat carry; active reasons have durations halved
doom_killed.scar: 'The last shop owner was killed' +6 (20d) added to everyone
doom_killed.trust_reset: trust = 0.5 * current (a new face, but the city remembers the family)
doom_killed.ledger: heir reads the ledger: sees previous run summary (end day, wealth, danger stage reached, warnings seen)
doom_killed.readable: The city keeps the scars; the death becomes a reason in people's lists.

day_cap.readable: You move on before anything ends.

phases: 1. morning: advance day; generate the morning report from yesterday's diffs
2. player phase: spend actions (2 on tutorial days 1-2, else 4)
3. contagion pass: threshold check per person over neighbors
4. gossip pass: greedy people and greedy hubs spread
5. market pass: heat drift + price reasons
7. relapse pass: old-habit reasons for neglected narrow people
9. meters: recompute city greed and mean trust
10. danger update: gain/decay, warning stage changes
12. night: reasons tick down one day
day_loop.city_greed_formula: city_greed = 0.75 * weighted_mean(person greed, hubs weight 2) + 0.25 * market_heat

economy.note: Each person earns 2 coins/day at night (wage). Keeps the median stable and drains never become permanent. Median person wealth (min 20) feeds the danger gap term.

city_generation.hub_rule: First listed person of each district is its hub (index 0).
city_generation.secrets_rule: Pick 4 of the 5 districts (seeded); in each, one seeded non-hub person becomes a secret-keeper with a seeded kind (food/money).
city_generation.base_greed: normal(type mean, 6) clamped [15,75]; fear 62, pride 64, envy 60 - the city starts deep in the warning band; secret-keepers 22
city_generation.neighbors: Ring within district (prev/next) plus 6 seeded cross-district pairs drawn from the 10 unordered district pairs.
city_generation.market_heat_start: uniform 55-70 (prices are already climbing when you arrive)
city_generation.previous_owner: Uncle Fenn, kind relative, disappeared. Seeded: death day 40-55, final wealth 300-450. The ledger holds his last month: early fair prices, then tilted deals, warnings logged and ignored, last entry: 'They were at the door. The ledger goes to whoever reads it. Don't be me.'

canonical_city.note: Frozen output of the generator at gen_seed 0. The GDD roster table is this table. sim.py asserts generator(0) matches it.

healer.policy: Days 1-2 tutorial: fair deals + kind words to the first hubs met. Days 3-5 trust phase: favors and fair deals in the focus district. Then: focus district = highest mean greed not yet secured (mean < 26). Target = focus hub if hub greed >= 30, else greediest non-narrow in focus. Deal: generous if wealth > 45 else fair; word kind for fear, honest for pride/envy. Protect discovered secrets (1 slot). If wealth < 30: one work_shop slot. If wealth > 60: one give_away slot to the greediest poor person. Never betrays; keeps promises.

tycoon.policy: Build phase (until mean trust of the 8 richest >= 72 or day 12): 3 fair deals to hubs/richest (honest words) + 1 favor to the lowest-trust hub; keeps wealth <= 100 via a give_away/favor if above. Sprint phase: 4 tilted deals on richest targets (flattering to pride, honest to others). If warning stage >= 2 or target trust mean < 65: one build-phase day. Reaches 250 and fires tycoon.

fallen_healer.policy: Healer policy days 1-12; promises the focus target on days 4, 8 (2 promises). Day 13: betrays the oldest promise, then exploits: 2 tilted deals on highest-trust people (flattering to pride) + 1 fair heal in focus + 1 slot that keeps wealth <= 110 (give_away x2 if above, else favor). Greed rises past 65 while the city cure finishes; fires fallen_healer.

random.policy: Each slot, seeded uniform: 50% random trade (random target, item, deal, intent), 15% favor, 25% work_shop, 10% give_away. Betrays/keeps promises 50/50.

reckless_greedy.target_ending: doom by death (control bot for the danger system)
reckless_greedy.policy: 3 exploitative deals on the richest targets (threatening words) + 1 favor to the richest (grease). Exposes discovered secrets for coin. Ignores all warnings. Should be killed by the city.

definitions.asserts: healer bot reaches healer >= 50%; tycoon bot reaches tycoon >= 50%; fallen bot reaches fallen >= 45%; reckless bot killed (doom_killed) >= 85%; passive bot doom >= 80%; each ending reached mainly by its intended bot (>50% of that ending's runs)
every run terminates in one of the 6 outcomes; passive bot median end day >= 20 (loses eventually, not instantly)

no achievement bot (healer/tycoon/fallen) reaches its target in > 70% of seeds; random bot healer rate < 10%. Note: doom is the failure state, not an achievement; reckless/passive reaching doom reliably is REQUIRED by the danger design.
pooled across all bots: >= 70% of runs see city_greed >= 60 at some point; >= 50% of runs see danger >= 30 (stage 1 warning)
healed people left alone relapse within 12 days (mean <= 9)
tipping a hub cascades: >= 3 neighbors tip within 12 days; healing the hub reverses: within 10 days >= 2 of those neighbors drop back below tip
reckless bot killed before day 60 in >= 95% of runs; warnings (stage 1) appear >= 5 days before death in every death
median run length 25-50 days pooled; day_cap outcome <= 15% pooled
24 generated cities x 6 bots x 4 seeds: outcome distributions differ across cities (report per-city healer-rate spread and total-variation distances)
3 consecutive runs with carry-over: healer -> tycoon -> fallen chain effects verified; killed-player path: heir inherits SAME city with scars and reaches an ending
healer bot discovers >= 1 secret on average (only cluster-adjacent secrets are reachable), corrupts <= 1, reckless bot corrupts/exposes when it touches secrets (>= 0.2 avg)

force city to ~85-86 (dark): the valve shock window is short (the city cools within days), so shocks fire in >= 50% of dark starts; the city never worsens; a working healer pulls it down (mean drop >= 8 points over 45 days) - recovery is possible and typical but a race, not a guaranteed save

sim_coverage.reason: sim.py proves the loop math is playable; presentation systems are specified in the GDD and JSON but do not affect the math.

ui_readability.why_list: Tap a person: header shows name, role, district. Body lists their active reasons in plain language with signs and remaining days, strongest first, e.g. 'You overcharged me +8 (2d left)', '3 of 4 neighbors greedy +10 (1d)', 'Fair deal from you -7 (4d)'. Locked behind trust: below 25 trust shows '???'; at 25+ shows a fuzzy estimate (calm/uneasy/greedy) and the top 2 reasons; at 60+ shows everything plus their true tip threshold and any secret hint.
ui_readability.morning_report: Plain-language summary every morning, generated from diffs: who tipped, who recovered, biggest movers, heat change, gossip themes, event, warning stage changes. Example: 'Day 12. The market tipped: 4 of 6 stalls now greedy. Prices rose again (heat 68). Old Cuttle told three people you got rich. Your danger: stares and whispers.'
ui_readability.meters: City greed and player greed always visible (bar + number). Individual greed hidden until trust. Danger never shown as a number, only warning stage banners.

dialogue_tags.rule: The simulation logic reads ONLY tags. Menu choices are pre-tagged lines. Character voice = plain data (formality, greed_vocab, pet_words).
dialogue_tags.later_model_plan: v1.1 ships an on-device small model: (1) free text -> tag classifier (the same tags), (2) tag -> line generator that rewrites in each character's voice, (3) if slow or low-confidence, fall back to the menu choices. Character memory (trust, reasons, secrets, promise state) stays plain data either way.

example.menu_choice: 'Fair price, same as always. Bread keeps well, you know.'

palette_bands.palette: burnt orange, rust, long hard shadows
ashen violet, black water, gold-only highlights

art_audio.sprites: Individual sprite tint follows personal greed; narrow people gain one small warm pixel accent (their 'small want').
art_audio.music: Layered chiptune: a rounds-based market theme loses a layer every 15 city-greed points; below 50 a detuned counter-melody fades in; at valve range only percussion and a single thin lead remain. Healing restores layers, never instantly.
art_audio.barks: Dialogue lines get shorter and crueler with city greed; hubs stop greeting you at warning stage 2.
art_audio.scars: Healed districts keep 1-2 scar pixels in tile art (healing is never permanent, visually).
art_audio.sfx: Coin SFX pitch rises with player greed; at stage 3 danger, night ambience gains a crowd murmur.

metaprogression.goal: Fill the wall of owners: one portrait per run, all four endings, across many cities.

decisions_log_summary: Full decisions log lives in GDD.md section 12. Every entry is labeled LOCKED (notes 1-19), ADOPTED / MODIFIED / REJECTED (notes 20), or NEW DECISION (notes 21 + design completion).
